name: Grave Robbers
source: Sylvania Supplement, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/grave-robbers) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: Weapons/Armour: The Graver may be equipped from the Grave Robber Hero equipment list.
Weapons/Armour: The Grave Robber may be equipped from the Grave Robber Hero equipment list.
Weapons/Armour: The Junior Medic may be equipped from the Grave Robber Hero equipment list.

specialRules.name: Sawbones
specialRules.description: You can re-roll the Serious Injury result for one friendly Hero. The second result stands. You may not use this ability if the Junior Medic was taken Out of Action during the battle.

heroSlots.notes: Weapons/Armour: Lookouts may be equipped from the Grave Robber Hero equipment list.

henchmenTypes.notes: Weapons/Armour: Thugs may be equipped from the Grave Robber Henchmen equipment list.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Pry Bar
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Strength As User. Parry: Whilst acting as a club in every sense, the pry bar allows the Graver to parry attacks.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Hooded Lantern & Rig
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Concealed Light: Provides light like a regular Lantern, but removes the visibility for enemy models. Free-hand: The Rig that the Hooded Lantern attaches to allows the Graver free hands with which to ply his trade.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Surgeon's Journal
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Skilled Hand: A Medic equipped with the Journal may modify a single dice rolled for Serious Injury for one friendly model by +/- 1 instead of using his Sawbones skill.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Finger Pendant
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Death-Ward: Gives a one-time 5+ save vs. Necromantic or Dark Arts magic.

specialRules: Grave Goods: Grave Robbers gain +1 Gold Crown for each enemy model taken Out of Action in the Exploration Phase (once per battle). | Shady Reputation: Grave Robber warbands may not hire the following Hired Swords: Bounty Hunter, Roadwarden, Law-Enforcer, Holy Man, or any Follower of Morr. | Undead Foes: Grave Robbers hate Undead models.
background: Some men are callous enough to steal the treasures buried with the dead. Such a sacrilegious thing is punished heavily, thus grave robbers are constantly on the run from the law. Such evil men are sought wherever they may try to hide, but few lawmen dare chase these villains into Sylvania. | Once in the dark and cursed lands, few criminals return. Some because they perish within its terrible claws, but others because they find their trade much more pliable. With graves literally emptying themselves, who is to stop one from liberating the riches within? | Not only riches, but the corpses that do remain dead are sought at a good price. While practitioners of dark arts have need for human remains, they are also valuable for students of medicine. Experienced groups of grave robbers are often so accustomed to death and hardened that they venture to Sylvania to loot the crypts of those who live after death. | Should the living dead not need it, then those unscrupulous men will definitely put it to better use.
